dedupe_keys.name: girreo global irrigation areas from earth observation 2023

description: GirrEO maps areas irrigated at least once in 2023 worldwide by combining Earth observation of vegetation with precipitation from climate reanalysis. A harmonic analysis of the 16-day, 250-metre MODIS-Terra vegetation index (MOD13Q1 v6.1) finds greenness peaks, and a peak that is not preceded by rain in the previous weeks flags the area as potentially irrigated. It was produced by Assimila Ltd and published on Zenodo in May 2025 as a GeoTIFF mask and shapefile at about 0.17-degree resolution, under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, which excludes commercial use. Caveats: it covers one year, marks where irrigation occurred, not how much water was applied, and aggregates to a coarse grid. Simulation uses: screening irrigated areas for irrigation capacity planning and climate adaptation. Related records: the Meier et al. global irrigated areas map (data-global-irrigated-areas-meier-2018) and GMIA-NEXT (data-gmia-next-global-irrigated-areas-30m).
